gloss: before the Buddhist altar; in front of Buddha

definitions.gloss: before the Buddhist altar; in front of Buddha
definitions.explanation: The space in front of a Buddhist altar ({仏壇|ぶつだん}) or image of the Buddha, where offerings are made and prayers are said. Also used in {御仏前|ごぶつぜん}, the label on condolence money offered after the funeral.

examples.japanese: {仏前|ぶつぜん}に{花|はな}を{供|そな}える。
examples.english: To offer flowers before the Buddhist altar.

examples.japanese: {毎朝|まいあさ}{仏前|ぶつぜん}で{手|て}を{合|あ}わせる。
examples.english: Every morning I put my hands together in prayer before the altar.

examples.japanese: {香典袋|こうでんぶくろ}には「{御仏前|ごぶつぜん}」と{書|か}いて{法要|ほうよう}に{持参|じさん}した。
examples.english: I wrote 'go-butsuzen' on the condolence envelope and brought it to the memorial service.

notes:
Refers to the area before the household altar or a Buddha image, the place for offerings and prayer. The polite form {御仏前|ごぶつぜん} labels condolence money given at or after the {四十九日|しじゅうくにち} memorial, in contrast to {御霊前|ごれいぜん} used before it.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {仏前|ぶつぜん}に{供|そな}える: to make an offering before the altar
- {御仏前|ごぶつぜん}: label for condolence money after the funeral

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {仏壇|ぶつだん}: Buddhist household altar — the altar itself
- {御霊前|ごれいぜん}: 'before the spirit' — condolence-money label used before the 49th-day rite
